In this paper, we are going to develop models and simulations for three kinds of ship physical fields such as sound filed, magnetic field and hydraulic pressure field. The proposed system can not only simulate independently, but also accomplish the physical fields of ships at the time and point. The system could also display real time simulation graphics automatically.

articleTitle: Study on SOBI Separation Method for Composite Materials Simulated Damage AE Signals
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper introduces an improved de-noising SOBI (Second Order Blind Identification) separation method, which is used to separate mixed components of different composite materials damage acoustic emission simulated signals. The contrastive analysis and numerical simulations of a variety of blind source separation algorithms are investigated, which suggests that traditional SOBI performance degrades when noise is present. By introducing noise-elimination algorithms, SOBI is improved and optimized. The improvement of separation effect of the de-noising SOBI algorithm is proved by numerical simulation experiments. Finally, based on the online structural damage simulation and monitoring test-bed, the feasibility of the proposed method is validated.

articleTitle: Application of Niching Genetic Extended Particle Filter in GPS/SINS Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Kalman filter is limited to apply to linear and Gaussian system only. Particle filter has the problem of degeneracy phenomenon and sample impoverishment caused by resampling. Aimed at solving problems above, this paper proposes Niching Genetic Algorithm Extended Particle Filter (NGA-EKPF), which improves resampling with niching genetic algorithm by integrating EKF to optimize importance distribution function. Theoretical analysis and computer simulation of positioning estimation precision in GPS/SINS integrated navigation system shows that algorithm proposed in this paper makes evident improvement in performance.

articleTitle: Research on Mission Planning Model of Future Surveillance Ship
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Surveillance ship plays an important role in spaceflight TT&C network with characteristics of integrated measurement and flexible deployment. With fields like space tracking and control innovating fast, there will be much more new and difficult tasks for ships. To make a better use of surveillance ships, it is worthy to study how to scheduling and planning missions of future surveillance ships. The paper try to analyze current demand and practical constraints. A flexible objective function with multiple principles is designed. A CSP model for mission planning and scheduling is established.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Design of the Locking Amplifier Based on Multisim
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The output signal of the sensor in real production often submerged in complex noise, how to extract useful signal from the noise pollution of signals has become a more important research content. Lock-in amplifier can be used between noise and useful signal frequency and phase different this feature to detect a specific frequency and phase of the signal. The use of this feature of the lock-in amplifier can be very good for weak signal detection[1] and analysis. In this paper, the composition and working principle of the lock-in amplifier are studied, and the effect of the lock-in amplifier on the noise is analyzed by simulation. The results show that the locking amplifier has the function of restraining the noise, and the signal can be extracted from the bad environmental noise.

articleTitle: Improved Alignment Method for a SINS Using Two Vector Measurements
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The attitude of the strap down inertial navigation system (SINS) in static base with respect to the Earth can be obtained directly using the TRIAD algorithm given two vector measurements. This is usually called analytic coarse alignment method in which all six outputs from the SINS are used to compute the attitude. In this study, we present a novel analytic alignment method called selective alignment. This method uses only three outputs of the SINS and some limited information from the remaining outputs to calculate the attitude. Simulations and experimental results demonstrate the validity of this method, and the precision of yaw is improved using the selective alignment method compared to the traditional analytic coarse alignment method in the vehicle experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Mongolian Folk Songs Based on EGG
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper describes the phonation study of Mongolian folk songs using three parameters, which is Fundamental frequency (F0), Open quotient (OQ), Speed quotient (SQ). The paper compares male and female singers aiming at summarize voice features of folk songs and correlations of each EGG parameters. The results show that whether song types, female singer's pitch is higher than male's, and it due to the female's physiological structure, There are different relationships between three parameters in different Mongolian folk songs, The long melody's F0 is higher than the short's, but the short melody's OQ and SQ are greater than long melody's.

articleTitle: Design of the Double-Channel Angle Measurement System Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Angle measurement is the key technology of digital control and angular position tracking in servo system. For the problem of low accuracy of angle measurement and error in coarse-fine data coupling, data fusion was applied in the double-channel angle measurement system. The angle was simultaneously measured by coarse channel and fine channel, then the coarse data and fine data was coupled by data fusion algorithm which has the function of error carry correction and zero correction. Finally, the upper-computer software was designed based on Lab VIEW to processing data and display angle. The text results showed the system can effectively improve the accuracy of angle measurement.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement Wireless Network of LEACH Based on Energy
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Using energy efficient way transmission is very important for extend the life of the sensor network. LEACH is a based on cluster protocol, it uses the local cluster random rotation mechanism will be the energy load is evenly distributed to all sensor nodes in the network. The cluster head will be collected and fusion data for base station. This paper proposes an improved scheme, using the random clusters algorithm for sensor node in the network into clusters, clusters of process thinking of sensor nodes remaining energy and the distance between the cluster and the cluster head nodes. By analyzing and simulating results that the new algorithm is more effective than LEACH by energy and send more data.

articleTitle: The Design of Center Sequential Control System for Galatea
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Galatea device is a prototype which is used to investigate plasma magnetic confinement. The power of each subsystem must meet strict sequence requirements when Galatea device is running. So we need precise timing control for multiple power supply in Galatea device to guarantee its normal work. The center sequential control system (CSCS) designed in this article is an important part of Galatea plasma magnetic confinement device, which is used to implement the sequential control of all the power. After the analysis of sequential control requirements of Galatea device, a CSCS based on SOPC technology was presented. This system synchronizes each power system of Galatea by using reference clock and delay trigger. The CSCS system can provide reference clock in frequency up to 48MHz. The trigger can be pre-defined from 0.1us to 4096s with 20ns accuracy. The CSCS system will be applied to the Galatea plasma magnetic confinement device, the experimental results confirmed its accuracy.

articleTitle: Average Transmit Power Gain of Adaptive ZF Large Scale Multi-user and Multi-antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper investigates adaptive zero-forcing (ZF) uplink transmission for a large-scale multi-user multi-antenna (MUMA) system. It is assumed that power control can be done at these transmitters as channel condition changes, and the number of antennas at the base station (BS) is not less than the number of users with each having single antenna. Under the case where both individual user rates and maximum transmit powers are constrained, we adopt the optimal transmit strategy of minimizing the total average transmit power (ATP). We define a concept called average transmit power gain (ATPG) for each link in the MUMA system in order to get an insight into the power benefits provided by the MUMA system over a single-user and single-antenna (SUSA) system. In Rayleigh fading environments, then we derive several ATPG expressions with and without channel estimation error. These expressions imply the relationship among the individual ATP, the individual outage probability, the number of BS antennas, and the number of users.

articleTitle: The Design of the Mobile Phone Module Information Encryption System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Today's society is more and more tends to the development of information technology and the popularity of mobile phones also makes personal information security issues concerned. The security transmission of mobile phone text messaging is particularly important. This article mainly designs a hardware encryption system based on GSM FPGA module and uses RSA public key encryption algorithm and implements the design of SMS encryption system. Currently RSA public encryption algorithm has become the most important password, which making up the RSA encryption algorithm slowly and exerting vital advantage of the large space of RSA algorithm key because of the speediness of hardware encryption, excellent reliability and good stability. Experiments show that FPGA-based RSA encryption system of this article proposing can guarantee the secure transmission of information and enhance the security of SMS transmission.

articleTitle: Investigation on Gas-Liquid Two-Phase Pressure Drop and Recurrence Characteristics across an In-Line Tube Bundles
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A comparative analysis of pressure drop of different flow pattern of two tube bundles was done. The results show that: the pressure drop of bubble flow is maximum, followed by intermittent flow, and mist flow becomes the minimum. Based on the statistical analysis of the different pressure signals, the power spectrum density versus frequency of the signals for major flow patterns was obtained. It is found that the flow patterns can be identified in accordance with the power spectrum density. The recurrence quantification analysis method was used to study the dynamic characteristics of differential pressure fluctuating signals of bubbly flow, intermittent flow, mist flow patterns. The research indicated isolated points texture appeared on recurrence plot for the bubbly flow. Both dispersed points texture and massive texture appeared on recurrence plot for the intermittent flow with strong chaos characteristic. The recurrence plot of mist flow whose idicated periodic is outstanding has a good diagonal texture. The recursion texture of differential pressure fluctuating signals could well reflect the evolution characteristics of flow pattern, and the recurrence characteristics quantities were obvious to the variations of superficial gas velocity and provided a new idea for investigation of gas-liquid two-phase flow mechanism.

articleTitle: Vertical Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To achieve missile erecting process run smoothly, this paper taking the arm vertex of the vertical bar as the object of the research. And it proposes a new method that polynomial interpolation is used to plan trajectory. By determining expressions of the trajectory of the various kinematic parameters, the graphic simulations of each variable are visually displayed in the paper. Further application of this method is made in SINS, and by programming the navigation solution, compared to the calculated results and the trajectory planned, the study verifies its influence on navigation precision in the inertial navigation. As the simulation results show, the method of Polynomial interpolation solves the problems of the conventional acceleration discontinuities. Therefore, the impact is much smaller as well as the deviation calculated by navigation solution, and the erecting process is more stable, furthermore the planned trajectory fits better, and the navigation accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: An Efficient WSN Routing Protocol on Airfield Lighting Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: There is advantage of fixed physical location for airfield lighting in airport lamp monitoring using WSN, but some lamps location is irregular, which caused large consumption of the cluster head nodes in this logic region, early death, the formation of voids during transmission, and these voids undermined the entire wireless sensor networks energy balance, reduced the WSN lifetime. To solve these problems a routing protocol was proposed with evenly distributed cluster head position. This protocol was composed of two parts, Chain transmission protocol and cluster-based routing protocol, the chain transmission protocol was applied to the irregular region (corresponding to the long row lamp position). And cluster-based routing protocol with logical partitions was applied to other regions. In the clustering routing protocol, the clustering head election algorithm was bound to join constraints. These two constraints were the distribution of the candidate cluster head in the region and the node energy limitation. In order to verify the validity of the protocol, simulations have been carried out with MATLAB referring the lighting position distribution in an airfield approach zone. Simulation results show that the protocol has good network energy balance ability. The sensor network has a long working lifetime, and which is suitable for airport lamp monitoring.

articleTitle: Software Fault Location Analysis Technology Based on Tarantula
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Software errors usually result from the interaction of related codes which need the analyzers to analyze a great number of codes to find out the causes. Based on dynamic slicing method, this paper focused on the dependence relationship of the execution code and taint analysis method to help to locate the fault code. We also made improvements on the open-source analyzer Tarantula and proposed another two parameters to describe the relationship between the related branch codes and the software errors. Experiments show that this method can help to locate fault codes more precisely.

articleTitle: Research on the Optical Frequency Sensing Based on Birefringence Photonic Crystal Fiber Slow-Light Interferometer
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, we report an optical frequency sensing system based on birefringence photonics crystal fiber slow-light interferometer, which takes advantage of the high birefringence feature of photonic fiber crystal (PCF) and slow-light based on Stimulated Brillouin Scattering (SBS). Through the theory analysis, it is proved that the system has a sensitivity that is 32.8 times higher than before due to the use of slow-light and PCF.

articleTitle: GASA Based Signal Reconstruction for Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Reconstruction, which is the core of compressive sensing (CS), can be implemented by l0 norm minimization. In practice, l0 norm minimization is a NP-hard problem that requires exhaustively listing all possibilities of the original signal and is difficult to achieve by traditional algorithms. This paper proposes a signal reconstruction algorithm combining genetic algorithm with simulated annealing algorithm which is famous for their superior performance in solving combinatorial optimization problems. The method in this paper can solve l0 norm minimization directly and can reconstruct noiseless signal accurately. It has been proved through numerical simulations that the theoretical optimization performance for signal reconstruction can be achieved. The quality of reconstruction based on the proposed method is superior to that of OMP, smooth l0 norm (SL0) algorithm, Lasso and BP algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Data Transfer Module Based on STM32 in Monitoring System of Cold Chain Transportation
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of centralized supervision, local distribution and overall mobility, a cold chain transportation monitoring system is designed. In this system, STM32 microprocessor is used as the main controller of the data transfer module, wireless module based on SX1212 chip is utilized to Ad Hoc network, GPRS module is utilized to upload data to server. This system can monitor temperature, humidity, battery capacity, and route information, to ensure smooth and safe operation of Cold Chain Transportation. The system is stably, safe, as well as energy saving.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction for Satellite Attitude Control System Based on Fuzzy-Parity Equation and Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Since present fault prediction method of satellite attitude control system cannot describe and predict the nonlinear system effectively, a new method based on fuzzy-parity equation and grey GM (1, 1) model is presented in this paper. Firstly, fuzzy-parity equation and Kalman filter are utilized to extract the fault feature of satellite actuator. Translation transformation and buffer operator are adopted to process the fault feature so as to establish an equal dimension and new information GM (1, 1) model. Then the development trend of the fault feature is predicted and the confidence level of one-step prediction result is evaluated through the prediction grey-level. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method can predict fault trend effectively and accurately.

articleTitle: Investigation on Gas-Liquid Two-Phase Flow Patterns across an In-Line Tube Bundles
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A high-speed video camera was used to study the flow patterns in the rectangular channel of vertical upward cross-flow of air and water in horizontal tube bundles. Experiments were conducted using in-line tube bundles with a pitch-to-diameter ratio of 1.3 and 1.8. Bubbly flow, intermittent flow and mist flow were identified by flow visualization, and a flow map was constructed as a function of gas and liquid superficial velocities. The information of a single-frame was extracted and made into time series. The recurrence quantification analysis method was used to study the dynamic characteristics of information entropy of gas-liquid two phase typical flow patterns and transition flow patterns. The results show that the recurrence plot of entropy series of transition flow patterns shows the process of flow transition. The characterization result showed that the recurrence plot of information entropy could well reflect the evolution characteristics of flow pattern, and the recurrence characteristics quantities were sensitive to the variations of superficial gas velocity and provided an auxiliary tool for investigation of gas-liquid two-phase flow mechanism.

articleTitle: Improved Self-Learning Particle Swarm Algorithm for Calibrating a Three-Axis Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper introduces self-learning mechanism into the basic particle swarm algorithm to present the improved particle swarm algorithm. The self-learning mechanism ensures that the particles can change their speed and positions base on self learning and the overall experience. The novel algorithm can dynamically increase the diversity of particle swarm offspring and reduce the human intervention in evolutionary process. Then, use the improved particle swarm algorithm to calibrate the errors of three-axis measuring system. Simulation results show that the improved particle swarm algorithm is effective and feasible and has a good performance in calibrating the errors of three-axis measuring system.

articleTitle: Designing Optimal Bandwidth Synthesis Frequency Sequences for VLBI Experiments Conducted Jointly by Chinese Deep Space Stations and VLBI Stations
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents the algorithm and results of designing optimal frequency sequences for Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) Bandwidth Synthesis (BWS) in VLBI experiments conducted jointly by Chinese Deep Space Stations (CDSS) and Chinese VLBI Stations (CVS). The optimization algorithm based on global search is intended to get lower peak side lobe level of delay resolution function and larger normalized Root Mean Square (RMS) bandwidth, both of which are totally determined by the frequency sequences. Since the effective receiver bandwidth is quite different for CDSS and CVS, compatible frequency set is taken into consideration in the algorithm. The effect of the loss of a channel of the frequency sequences on their performance is also evaluated.

articleTitle: A New PI Algorithm for Single Stage Three-Phase Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Inverter Based on Power Feed-Forward
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The single-stage photovoltaic grid-connected system uses only once energy conversion to complete two functions: Maximum power point tracking (MPPT)and grid connected, so it has a large advantage of cost and efficiency. This paper research the Single Stage Three-phase Grid-connected Photovoltaic Inverter. Against the slow response of the DC bus voltage for the control of the traditional double-loop, being not conducive to the quick search of MPPT, this article makes the power feed forward algorithm be applied to the outer ring of the system control, and comparison with the traditional double-loop PI control. In addition, Against the unreasonable of the regulator design and the issues of the Parameters trial, PI regulator parameter design for in-depth research, Through detailed theoretical derivation, we come up with a new design PI regulator approach. The experiment verificates the new design method of PI parameters and the effectiveness of power feed forward control algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Weak Signal Measurement System for Electric-Field Measurement of Transformer Oil Based on Kerr Effect
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the Kerr constant of liquid medium is small, it is difficult to accurately detect the weak signals which from electric field measurement of transformer oil based on Kerr effect. To improve the accuracy of weak signal measurement, a weak signal measurement system was designed in this paper, which consists of signal channel module, reference channel module and phase sensitive detector module. The structure parameters of the lock-in amplifier processing system were designed carefully, and the measurement performance of the designed weak signal measurement system were tested. The test result showed that the weak signal measurement system can measure the low SNR weak signals accurately, and the measuring error were less than 2μV when there was 1mV signal noise or not. The weak signal measurement system possesses high linearity and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Survey on MapReduce Scheduling in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A large-scale data processing is increasingly leveraging Map Reduce frameworks on Cloud computing platform. We aimed to study various job schedulers improved in Map Reduce, and identify research directions in this area. In this paper, the related techniques of Map Reduce and Hodoop are described briefly. Then a variety of Map Reduce schedulers are reviewed and classified, also the features of these schedulers are expressed.

articleTitle: Attribute Characteristics Analysis and Compare between AT and APOSD
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Attribute Topology (AT) is a simple and visual representation method of formal concept. By AT, the formal concept can be computed visually and parallel. Attribute partial ordered structure diagram (APOSD) is based on the partial order relationships in math and focus on the cover and inclusion among attributes. Although AT and APOSD have already achieved mutual transformation, the definition and characteristics of attribute is not universal. This paper mainly analysis and compares the definition of attributes in AT and in APOSD, and demonstrate the equivalence of correspondingly attributes.

articleTitle: A Weighted Frequent Itemsets Mining Algorithm Based on Perpendicular Data Format
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Mining frequent item sets from a large dense type database may generate a large number of frequent item sets, and it may generate redundant information in some cases. To address these problems, a weighted frequent item sets mining algorithm based on perpendicular data format is proposed in this paper. The algorithm uses constrains of support and weight together, and then by uses item sets extension to mine weighted frequent item sets which meet the support and weight constraints at the same time. In order to reduce the number of candidate item sets, the algorithm used two methods, the first is pruned using property of weighted effectively extension, and the second is use hash table to store weighted non frequent binomial set.

articleTitle: A Collected Blocking Collision Tree Algorithm with Bit Tracking for RFID Tag Identification
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In many radio frequency identification (RFID) applications, a RFID reader repeatedly identifies the tags in its scope. An anti-collision algorithm with blocking mechanism lets the staying tags and arriving tags reply in different time periods and the collisions between the staying and arriving tags are prevented. However, in the existing blocking algorithms, the reader can only identify two staying tags at most in a slot. As a result, when the number of staying tags is large, the reader still consumes many slots to identify the staying tags. Thus, this paper proposes a collected blocking collision tree algorithm (CBCT) in which a bit tracking technology is used to enhance the system efficiency. Two key mechanisms are adopted in CBCT which are collecting and refreshing. By using the collecting mechanism, the reader can identify many tags in a slot. The refreshing mechanism is used by the reader to keep the continuity of all the staying tags. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is superior to the existing blocking algorithms and the algorithms with bit tracking technology.

articleTitle: Long Time Coherent Integration in Space Objects Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For space objects detection with radar, serious crossing-range and crossing-Doppler cell migration makes coherent integration capability limited. Long time coherent integration in space objects detection is studied. We discuss the disadvantages of LFM signal for coherent integration and put forward one method based on single-frequency signal to achieve long time coherent integration. The new method only needs to construct several acceleration compensating functions based on the estimated radial acceleration, and radial acceleration can be obtained through FFT in slow time domain. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Underwater Acoustic Network MAC Layer Protocol Attack
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Because of the importance of underwater acoustic network MAC layer protocol, feasibility and simulation analysis of underwater acoustic network MAC layer protocol attack were carried out in this article. The principle of underwater acoustic network MAC layer protocol attack was introduced, simulation analysis of performance of attacking methods, including modification of back off time and NAV values, was carried out, the simulation results showed that in special settings, MAC layer protocol attacking methods cause the network throughput degraded to less than 50% of the throughput level without attacking, in the same time, the network end to end delay came to about 200% level of the end to end delay without attacking.

articleTitle: Knowledge Aided Ground Moving Target Tracking Processing Method
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Tracking ground moving targets with airborne radar cannot guarantee track quality and continuity due to high target density, high clutter, and low visibility. In order to solve this problem, all kinds of aided information are widely utilized in different ways. As to a kind of aided information given as geospatial map, this paper proposes a new aided knowledge fusion method. Via performing the road judgment and shadow judgment in geospatial point perspective, the new fusion method reduces the implementation complexity significantly. The simulation results prove that the new aided knowledge fusion method proposed by this paper can fuse the aided information effectively in ground moving targets tracking.

Author Keywords: variable structure interacting multiple model filter

articleTitle: Application of Energy Projection Method Based on LMD in Fault Feature Extraction of Bearing Type
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the non-stationary and multi-scale characteristics of the bearing fault signal, a method of extracting the fault feature of bearing based on Local Mean Decomposition (LMD) energy projection is proposed. Firstly, the LMD method is utilized to decompose the bearing fault signal, and the feature frequency components of the signal are separated at the same time. Secondly, the decomposition of the main product function component weighted optimization and eliminate false composition, feature reconstruction PF components and to enhance the signal characteristic information. At last, the energy of the acquired PF is projected to a special frequency area, based on the energy distribution of structure bearing so avoidance signal feature vector to obtain low dimension feature vector. Experimental results show that the proposed approach is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Target Re-identification Based on Target's Appearance and Space Features
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Target re-identification of cross-camera is a difficult problem in the field of multi-camera surveillance, which needs to be urgently solved. Traditional solutions are mainly depend on the characteristics of target appearance. But these methods easily have the problem of low reliability and easily lead to low matching rate, because of losing targets' space information. In this paper, we will use targets' appearance and space information to make multi-layer histogram to describe targets, and by comparing the corresponding histograms to achieve target re-identification. At last, Experiments of targets re-identification for different cameras show that the proposed method can achieve good results.

articleTitle: Smart Emulator Control Based on Facial Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As an important branch of the computers, machine vision technology has a great influence on intelligent surveillance, human-computer interaction, and virtual reality. This paper introduced an intelligent emulator which used machine vision technology to guide navigation. The intelligent emulator is controlled by the human posture. The hardware of intelligent emulator includes control unit, obstacle avoidance module, photosensitive module, DC motor module, etc. PC sends instructions to microcontroller through the serial port. Microcontroller can control relay switch under the action of ULN2003AN when it received the instruction, then Microcontroller control the power modules which provide 6v dc to DC motor module. The different levels make two DC motor rotate forward rotate or backward, and realize the emulator's movement. At the same time, the front, rear, left and right of the emulator were installed with the ultrasonic ranging module to avoid the obstacle. When the distance between the emulator and the obstacle is less than the safe distance of 40 cm, the emulator will stop. In addition, we set an appropriate threshold, the intelligent emulator will stop if the brightness is less than the threshold. Photosensitive resistance will determine whether the emulator meet the dark environment that the host computer cannot continue tracking the movement of head.

articleTitle: A Pronunciation Rhythm Perception Study of Chinese
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A pronunciation rhythm perception study of Chinese is an important part of language study. Analyzing the available research achievement on the research method and research content from the Perspective of theoretical linguistics, acoustic phonetics, and psycholinguistics, this paper finds that the existing research is mainly about speech prosodic hierarchy, prosodic features, speech rhythm perception parameters (such as Stress-accent, intonation, duration, fundamental frequency, etc.) and their cognitive processing. This paper also further points out the problems existing in the research.

articleTitle: 3D Imaging System of Two-Photon Excitation Laser Scanning Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Laser scanning microscopy is a powerful tool for analyzing the structure and function of biological specimens. Although there exist numerous commercial laser scanning microscopes, the lack of supporting software system poses a great challenge to three dimension (3D) imaging in the study of two-photon excitation laser scanning microscopy (2PLSM). This paper proposes a complete framework for developing such software system and implements this complex software system with the combination of Lab VIEW and OpenGL. Firstly, the volume data is captured by scanning the specimen in 3D with laser. Secondly, the acquired data is processed with image mean filtering and image interpolation algorithm. Finally, the ray-casting algorithm is adopted to fulfill volume visualization. Based on the proposed framework, we develop an interactive user interface with Lab view to facilitate 3D data acquisition and image reconstruction. In addition, 3D display of the image is achieved using OpenGL, which makes it easier to observe the 3D image from different angles. The imaging results show that the proposed software system successfully images specimens in three dimensions with sub-micrometer resolution.

articleTitle: Calibration of Relative Deviation of Star-Sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The attitude determination precision of strap-down star-sensor restrict by its relative installation error, which must be calibrated and compensated. In this paper an algorithm for the calibration of relative deviation of star sensor is presented based on gyros and star-sensors. For the issue of relative deviation between star-sensors in the gyro/star-sensor attitude determination system, this paper sets one star-sensor as the fiducial star-sensor, relative deviation is reflected in the form of multiplicative noise in the output of the other. Extended Kalman filter (EKF) is used to estimate the state variable, which the relative deviation error is expanded into, in real time to improve the precision of attitude. Simulation results demonstrate that this on-orbit algorithm is effective to calibrate the relative deviation between star-sensors.

articleTitle: Formalizing the Coding Rules of Clinical Terminology on Traditional Chinese Medicine Using Formal Concept Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Formalizing of the coding rules of clinical terminology on Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is an important aspect of medical information mining and has attracted interests of researchers in such diverse fields as information visualization and formal concept analysis (FCA). The main purpose of this paper is to show the use of FCA to formalize and visualize the dependencies of TCM clinical terminology. First, the TCM term and its description are defined as the object and attribute, then the hierarchical relationships of TCM terms has been formalized by concept lattice, finally anonymous nodes and non-disjoint nodes are employed for auditing the completeness, consistency and correctness of the coding rules of TCM terminology. The proposed method is validated by experiments with the case study, which demonstrates that it should be possible to produce a FCA-based method of formalizing and auditing the semantic completeness of TCM terminology.

articleTitle: The Design of Intelligent Weighing Apparatus Monitoring Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the metrology department and promote the development of intelligent weighing apparatus, this paper proposes the design of the weighing monitoring system from two aspects of measurement system and monitoring system. In the measuring end, STC89C52 microcontroller is used as the main control chip to achieve the accurate measurement of pressure. The temperature drift of the pressure sensor is reduced by using the pressure sensor temperature compensation algorithm based on the combination of Lagrange difference and least square. The monitoring system uses the upper computer, the Wi-Fi module and the Android mobile phone to remotely monitor the measurement system intuitively, receives and displays the measurement data in real time, and can invoke the historical data. The system realizes the real-time monitoring of the weighing instrument and makes the weighing instrument become the integrated remote monitoring equipment, which has many functions such as data analysis, remote diagnosis and remote operation. This design is of great significance to study the intelligent weighing field.

articleTitle: Euclidean-Based Entity Resolution for Evolving Data
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With large companies and corporations becoming increasingly responsible for data collection, in recent years, a growing number of scientists have proposed using a variety of algorithms and different theories to solve the database problem. Even though existing solutions are effective in many cases many, problems are left to solve during the integration of database. The entity resolution (ER) is a crucial problem to solve. ER has been used in many applications during the updating and loading process of the big data set, while the evolving data needs most. The evolving data set are currently used in the biology and computer information a lot, which contains microscope observation and biology information. Even though researchers have proposed different ER methods, the cost of ER problems is usually too large to accept. We use the high-dimensional space Euclidean vector to simulate the states of different entities in big data set. We combine this approach with the parallel improved Top-K algorithm, devising a way to more effectively detect the identity of the entity. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the proposed method could perform entity resolution on evolving data effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: NURBS Cutter Location Controlling Method in 5-Axis CAM/CNC
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Recently, more and more Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) curves are broadly utilized to approximate the arbitrary contour of a complex shape part in the Computer Aided Design (CAD) field. In this paper, the new accurately controlling method based on NURBS curves is proposed and realized about cutter location (CL) and federate in a 5-axis manufacturing system. In this method, the tool paths and the cutter locations were firstly represented into NURBS curves based on the same knot vector. And then the above CL data were calculated and finally transformed into five motion controlling commands of five axes of machine tool through the real-time post-processing program. The acceleration/deceleration controlling method is also presented to avoid the impact of machine tool. The proposed 5-axis real-time controlling method about CL and federate is realized and the experimental result of 5-axis machining shows that the presented method is corrected and also can be utilized in the Computer Aided Design and Computer Numerically Controlled (CAM/CNC) field.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Hadoop-Based Spatial-Temporal Outlier Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A spatial-temporal outlier is an object whose non-spatial attribute value is significantly different from those of other objects in its spatial and temporal neighbors. Identifying or detecting spatial-temporal outliers will help us find some unexpected, interesting and useful knowledge in many application fields, for example: financial fraud detection, fault diagnosis, network intrusion detection and so on. However, the existing spatial-temporal outlier detection algorithms can't efficiently deal with big dataset. In this paper, a Hadoop-based spatial-temporal outlier detection algorithm is proposed. This approach takes the spatial autocorrelation into consideration. Therefore, the weight is introduced in the approach. However, the calculation involved in calculating weight is significantly large. Besides, the big dataset needs to be processed in this approach. Therefore, Hadoop is used to improve it's performance. The Ningbo sea tide dataset is used to validate the effectiveness and scalability of this approach.

articleTitle: The Double Immunization Strategy Research Based on the Tibetan Web Community Division
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Through real time crawling network topology structure of Tibetan Web, analyzing the topology structure, first of all do the community division to find the nodes with the weak ties features by network topology structure and the theory of the community division. At the beginning of the immune, the nodes with weak ties are immune first, then the maximum degree of acquaintance immunization strategy were used according to the structure features of the community. Through analyzing the experimental data, the computation and immune cost of immunization strategy proposed in this paper are relatively smaller, and the immune effect are better, the method can effectively reduce the harm of the virus spreading to the network.

articleTitle: Construction and Evaluation of Customer Satisfaction Index System in E-Shopping
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Customer satisfaction influencing factors in E-shopping were analyzed in this paper. An index system on customer satisfaction was constructed based on 19 indicators from five categories in E-shopping. Analytic Hierarchy Process was used to calculate the weight of each indicator and this establishes a foundation for further empirical research.

articleTitle: The Effect Factor of Stochastic Resonance System for Scale-Transformation Method
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The scale-transformation method make the stochastic resonance (SR) system can processing the underwater acoustic frequency, there are many factor to effect the output, this paper study on the effect factor of the SR system, the result shown that The signal can be detected from the spectrum of the output when fs is bigger than 20 times f0. If fs is less than 20 times f0, the output is not ideally, even mis convergence, Higher scale factor bring lower transition frequency at higher SNR, if the SNR is low, the output would mis convergence when higher scale factor, The system parameter a is more effect to the output than b.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of AS-Level Internet Evolution Based on Temporal Distance
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the Inter-domain routing security problem becomes increasingly prominent, the detection of AS (Autonomous System)-level Internet evolution has become a research hotspot. This paper introduces AS Reach ability Distance (ASRD) and AS Connectivity Distance (ASCD) based on temporal distance, used to characterize the difference of AS reach ability and connectivity at different time respectively, and based on ASRD and ASCD, an algorithm of continuously detecting AS-level Internet anomalies is proposed. Experiments show that the proposed method can not only detect AS-level Internet anomalous event accurately, but also reveal the evolution laws of AS-level Internet in the long term.

articleTitle: NDVS: A System of News Data Visualize
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This article leads the concept of data visualization into the huge amounts of news data, design and implements a system of News Data Visual System (NDVS). It is a news gathering, analysis, structured storage and visual analysis system. NDVS collects news data in the schedule time from seeds website by a web spider that written by java every day. The structured documents that processed and analyzed by detached parameters from URL and classify news will be saved in distributed database of NOSQL -- MongoDB. WEB will visually and interactively animate the documents in the means of D3.js. Design and realization of NDVS will be emphasized in the article, and we find that NDVS has a good capability when lots of clients concurrent access. We believe NDVS will become a useful tool between news and media works, because system follows the usability policy that helps people to find the potential tendency of news' development and guide the public opinion in the stage of visualization design.

articleTitle: Study on Integrated Recognition for Ballistic Targets Based on Grey Incidence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Ballistic target recognition is a key process in anti-missile combat. In this paper, the movement characteristics and physical characteristics of ballistic target are analyzed, some ideas or methods to save extracted information, to create template sequence and to recognize ballistic target on grey relational analysis are proposed. Based on these, we give the method to calculate the grey incidence degree of single character sequence of target, and establish an approach to integrate grey relational degree of multiple character sequences, which can give order of trueness degree of various targets. Method in this paper is a new approach of integrated recognition for ballistic targets.

articleTitle: Design of LXI-Serial Communication Adapter
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The new instrument bus LXI has broad prospects for development. LXI-Serial communication Adapter plays an important role in Hybrid Test Systems based on LXI as it connects serial devices with LXI-Bus instruments. This paper gives a design of LXI-Serial communication Adapter based on ARM and FPGA and discusses the details of embedded software and FPGA logic. LXI-Serial Adapter, which provides seamless connectivity between the serial interface instruments and the LXI test system, should be conformed to the LXI Standard and the serial communication protocol. On the basis of thoroughly analyzing about specifications of LXI Standard, network and serial communication specifications, this scheme of this module is brought forward according to the domestic application needs. The actual test indicates that the communication between serial devices and LXI-Bus instruments can be achieved securely.

articleTitle: A Low-Overhead Cooperative Failure Detector
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Failure detectors are one of the fundamental components for ensuring the high availability of large scale distributed system. The increasing popularity and demand for the large scale distributed system came with an increase in the overhead and complexity of failure detection that posed a challenge obstructing further development. In order to solve the challenge, this paper proposes a new failure detector -- S-AFD which combines adaptive failure detection based on QoS (quality of service) and cooperative mechanism that share negative messages among different active nodes. It does not only reduce the detection overhead, but also adapt the various network conditions. Through analysis of experiments, it is shown that the performance of S-AFD has a clearly improvement compared with the traditional implementations of failure detectors.

articleTitle: Experimental Study with Rapid Measurement for Moisture Content of Iron Concentrate
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the real-time measurement method of the moisture content of iron concentrate is studied, and the real-time monitoring of the water content of iron concentrate is realized by using the AM2305. The moisture sensing mechanism of capacitive moisture sensor is discussed, and the scheme of measuring moisture content based on MPS430 microcontroller is presented. On this basis, the mathematical model of the relationship between the water and moisture content of iron concentrate is set up by the sample configuration, experimental data collecting, analysis and calibrating. The feasibility of the method of measuring the water content of iron concentrate by using the AM2305 is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Infrared Target Tracking Based on Color Fusion Image and Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To deal with the poor stability of tracking infrared target by using the gray-level features in traditional methods, a novel method is provided for tracking target in infrared based on color image fusion. Firstly, This method uses the color transfer technology to achieve the color fusion image for the infrared target. On the basis of the color image, the color histogram is established by kernel function for infrared target model. Finally, particle filter algorithm was adopted to realize the stable tracking of the infrared target. Simulation experiments using public databases of multiple sets of image sequence, the results show that the proposed method is better than traditional methods using the grayscale features and achieve the stable tracking for infrared target under complex environment.

articleTitle: Synchronization of a Class of Hyperchaotic Systems via Backstepping and Its Application to Secure Communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Researches on multi-scroll hyper chaotic systems, which present excellent activities in secure communication, are comparatively poor. There are no systematic design methods and current methods are difficult to deal with uncertainties. In this paper, an adaptive back stepping control is proposed. The adaptive updating laws are presented to approximate the uncertainties. The proposed method improves the robust performance of controller by only two control input. The asymptotical convergence of synchronization errors is proved to zero by Lyapunov functions. Finally, simulation examples are presented to demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed synchronization control scheme and its validity in secure communication.

articleTitle: Construction and Evaluation of Regional Socialized Service System of Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, a regional socialized service system of agriculture was constructed by using factor analysis and clustering analysis. The system included twenty one indicators of five categories. Furthermore, the statistical analysis software SPSS was used to evaluate the socialized agricultural service condition of western twelve provinces in China. The twelve provinces were divided into three classes and the socialized agricultural service levels of each class were evaluated.

articleTitle: An Effective Measurement Scheme of Node Influence in Aviation Network
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aviation network is the typical information network, where the airports can be regarded as nodes, and the airlines between airports can be regarded as links. But with the constraints with the Degree-Centrality, Closeness-Centrality and the Centrality between nodes, traditional researches on the influence of the information network developed slowly. Thus, we do some experiments on the traditional methods which used in the researching on the influence of the information network. And during experiments, we find that traditional methods have two drawbacks: (1) Universality is an unpredictable factors because some indicators are not suitable for any occasion. For instance, when the size of information network extends very large, it may needs a lot of time to compute the Closeness-Centrality and the the Centrality between nodes. (2) Node is such difficult to select correctly. For example, it is an NP-hard problem to select K as the most influential node because it has a very high computational complexity. This paper proposed a new perspective to depict the node influence in information network: By doing research on susceptible sides of the node depicts the node influence in aviation network. Simultaneously, this scheme includes the measurement method of non-directional and directional network. And we use the Independent-Cascade-Model to evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of our method. Because of the lack of real aviation network data, we apply our method on three similar real network data-sets (Hamsterster full, Ca-HepTh etc). And the result refers to the experiments show that our method exceeds the greedy algorithm of influence maximization on the spread influence. Moreover, this also show that our method not only can be suited to the aviation networks, but also can be used in other information networks. Therefore, Our scheme can accurately depict the node influence in information network.

articleTitle: Further Results on the Beamforming Transmission Scheme Only Using the Specular Component for Massive-MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For massive MIMO systems over Ricean fading channels, in order to reduce the overhead for estimating channel state information, we have presented a transmit/receive beam forming transmission scheme only based on the specular component, and derived asymptotical results about its achievable rate when the number of antennas grows without bound. It has been shown by simulation results that massive MIMO systems are suitable to be deployed in Ricean fading environments. In this paper, we continue to investigate the proposed BF scheme. In particular, we present some novel numerical results and analysis results, which are helpful for us to design a practical massive-MIMO system.

articleTitle: Research on Ofdm and the Single Carrier Signal Modulation Recognition
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, the communication technology is developing rapidly and the way of the modulation of communication signals is sundry. Therefore, it is become very meaningful to do some research on OFDM and single carrier signal modulation recognition between class, as well as the single carrier signal modulation recognition within class. However, most traditional algorithms of these two types modulation recognitions are complex and have a big calculation. So it is very necessary to make improvements and reduce the computational complexity of the algorithms. This thesis does some analysis on the traditional method to reduce the computational complexity by extracting the new characteristic parameters.

articleTitle: Cross Bilateral Filtering Using Joint Histograms
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the increasing of the diversity of imaging methods, multimodal images are applied in more wide field. But due to the constrain of the bang, multimodal image are sometimes polluted by noise. Cross Bilateral Filter (CBF) is one of the state of the art method which can denoising two multimodal images which are polluted by noise at the same times. In this paper we proposed an Cross Integral Histogram based method which can speed up the the CBF, and the computation complexity in independent of the filter size. The experiment shows that at the appropriate filter size the proposed method can gain one order speed up compare with CBF method while producing similar filtering results.

articleTitle: TV Corner Mark Recognition Algorithm Based on Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper proposed a fusion of color features, shape features and SURF image recognition algorithm. Traditional SURF algorithm take greyscale image as input to extract local extreme value points as characteristics points, ignoring color and shape information. The paper introduced the global color histogram information to make up the lack of color information loss, at the same time introduced shape context descriptor to describe shape feature of the image. Then merge three feature descriptors to form joint feature descriptor, and gives different weights to different characteristics. The experimental results show that the algorithm has good recognition ability.

articleTitle: Design of Radar Signal Simulator Based on the CPCI Bus
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Radar signal simulator play a key role in radar debugging, performance evaluation and equipment maintenance. The large bandwidth, high power transmitter is always a hot research area in radar signal. The radar signal simulator used as the signal source, can generate multi-channel arbitrary waveform by software programming which can meet the requirement of real-time signal output. With the development of integrated circuit, the work clock of FPGA improve constantly, FPGA combined with DA can be used to produce any broadband signal. This paper introduces a design scheme of radar signal source by combining FPGA with four DAC chips of 1.6GHz sampling rate, using industrial CPCI bus structure makes the system more versatility, compatibility and scalability.

articleTitle: Investigation of Fault Diagnosis Model of Rotary Kiln Based on Improved Algorithm of Bayesian
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Bayesian Network is one of the most efficient and reliable method in data mining, and Bayesian Network structure learning is a key link in the process of Bayesian Network research. Aiming at the problem of the classic Hill-Climbing algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum and low in efficiency, establishing the Most Weight Supported Tree by calculating the mutual information, and combining the Most Weight Supported Tree and the simplified Hill-Climbing algorithm, proposes a new improved Bayesian Network structure learning algorithm. Comparing with the classic Hill-Climbing algorithm and K2 algorithm, the simulation experiments shown that the improved algorithm not only can obtain a high accuracy rate model, but improve the efficiency of building model. Based on the improved algorithm and combined with JiDong cement's cement rotary kiln operating data, we can establish the fault diagnosis model of cement rotary kiln and realize a precise and rapid fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Logical Petri Nets with Data
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A logical data petri net (LDPN), a logical data workflow net (LDWN) and a collaborative logical data workflow net (CLDWN) are represented. They are improved formal models extended with data variables, guards and the output condition expressions based on our previous models. Data variables are used to represent data. Guards are used to indicate the additional constraint related to data except for a token. The output condition expressions are used to clearly show the condition in which post places of logical output transitions get a token. A typical example of collaborative electronic commerce systems with the batch function and passing value indeterminacy is used to show the advantage of the improved models.

articleTitle: Shifting Focal Point of Light Source to Decrease FRD of Astronomical Optical Fibers in LAMOST
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The light from out space is very weak and to guide the light into the optical fiber efficiently in astronomical spectrum telescope is of great importance for spectrum analysis. And the FRD of optical fiber can also decrease the utilization of the light of celestial body for the expending diameter of the out spot from the optical fiber, which makes the spot more diffuser and decrease the distribution of energy density. The light from out space is focused to the focal plane in the telescope to couple into the fiber, but the focal point of the star light can be hardly controlled to be fixed on the incident end of the fiber, a common method of spinning the fiber to aim at the focal point automatically can efficiently track the path of the light point but not the focal point. So to optimize the transmission of light in the fiber can begin with FRD control by shifting the focal point of light source. Experiments results of testing the FRD of fibers in LAMOST with two kinds of light sources and two kinds of CCDs shows that shifting the focal point back behind the incident end of optical fiber can decrease FRD and the out focal ratio is more stable, the coefficient index can be up to 0.999.

articleTitle: Study of Effective Vector Synthesis Sequence for Three-Phase Current Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and reliability of the phase conversion process of three-phase current source rectifier (CSR), in this paper, the traditional space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) strategy of the six sectors for three-phase CSR is changed into a novel SVPWM strategy of the twelve sectors. And by changing the synthesis sequence of effective vector, the power tube which is not in the natural commutation state is made to be do it. Moreover, zero-current switching can be achieved, thus switch loss and voltage stress can be decreased. The proposed space vector modulation technology achieves the expected goals. The simulation and selected experimental results are reported in order to validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Transformation Properties in Attribute Topology and Attribute Partial Ordered Structure Diagram
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Attribute Topology (AT) and Attribute Partial Ordered Structure Diagram (APOSD) are both important research methods of Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) and Knowledge Discovery. Each of them can transform into the other with solid mathematical foundation and specific algorithm. Basing on set theory, this paper mainly researches and identifies the properties between related attributes, between attribute and AT, between attribute and APOSD. All of above is for the purpose of clarifying the relationships and properties in the transformation of AT and APOSD.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Fire Evolution in the Chemical Industrial Zone Based on Cellular Automata Method
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Chemical industrial accident is a complex system which evolves forward with the time passing. It is important to recognize the characteristics of accident evolution at different time nodes and the emergency decision-making will be improved scientifically and targeted. With respect to the characteristics of chemical industrial accident, the method of chemical industrial accidents evolution and ratiocination based on cellular automaton method is proposed. Hazard bearing body of fire in chemical industry zone can be represented into cellular automaton and main attributes of the cellular automaton were under consideration including flammability, combustion coefficient, wind coefficient and air humidity. The cellular automaton model with two dimension eight neighbors was proposed and scenario evolution chain can be established based on time series. The real-time information of the fire macroscopical expansion process will be provided in different conditions to the decision-makers.

articleTitle: Joint Frame Synchronization and CCSDS Convolutional Code Identification Based on Correlation of Codeword
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the problems involving frame synchronization and convolutional code identification for CCSDS link protocol are tackled. By combining the correlation of convolutional codeword and the theory of association rule mining, a new joint frame synchronization and code identification method is presented. It uses sequence position association to identify periodic frequent sequences and then match them with the prior knowledge of convolutional encoded CCSDS ASM. The method realizes the convolutional code identification and frame synchronization without the information of codeword starting point, the code block length and code rate. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate that this method can detect the code rate of CCSDS Link Protocol standard and achieve frame synchronization within a certain error rate range.

articleTitle: CAPS Satellite Data Push Communications System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the application needs of CAPS (Chinese Area Positioning System) in a particular field, we design and implement the CAPS satellite data push communications system. The system mainly includes data transmission equipment in the satellite central station (document broadcast software, data packers, jammers, modulators, high power amplifier and antenna), Slightly Inclined Geo-Synchronous Orbit satellite, receiving terminal equipment (terminal antenna tracking SIGSO satellite, receiver front-end processing, receiver demodulation processing). The system has a data transfer rate of 4Mbps in satellite data push, which is well to meet the application needs in relevant field.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Single-Cycle Inner Loop Control to Single Phase High-Frequency Link Matrix Converter
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Application of single-cycle control of the inverter can enhance the inverter DC input immunity. Controlling auxiliary voltage and current outer loop in a single cycle, the load capacity of a single-cycle control can be improved. In this paper, for single-phase voltage-type high frequency link matrix inverter, we study a new multi-loop SPWM control strategy based on single-cycle inner control. Simulation results show its effectiveness in restraining the DC side disturbance and carrying load capacity.

articleTitle: The Exploration and Realization of Clothing Sizes Support System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The research and application of data warehouse and data mining technology is the core in this paper. The design and implementation of "The productive apparel sizes and styles auxiliary decision system" is the main line. The effect of productive sizes support system is to guide the sizes quantity and enhance production efficiency based on the result of sizes compression and sales trend analysis.

articleTitle: Research of Selection Algorithm in Vehicles Mobile Networks Based on 3G/WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the limitation of the architecture in traditional vehicle communication networks, a new architecture of the fusion heterogeneous network based on 3G/WiMAX is designed. In order to roam in 3G/WiMAX networks seamlessly, a fuzzy neural network access selection algorithm optimized on the basis of ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm is put forward. The proposed algorithm takes radio signal strength, terminal moving speed and network bandwidth into consideration to process fuzzy neural network processing module. The specialty of the algorithm is using ACO to optimize and adjust the parameters of membership function. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can decrease the packet dropping probability, reduce the happening times of Ping-Pong effect and decrease the blocking probability on the consideration of guaranteeing the QoS for users.

articleTitle: Effective User Invitation Models for Online Survey Using Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the continuous and rapid development of online questionnaire survey, the low response rate has plagued operating companies. To solve this problem, this paper proposed an effective user invitation model by our improved clustering algorithm, which analyzed large-scale historical user behavior characteristic data, including users' quality data, users' preferential data and users' similarity data. Extensive experiments with large-scale data from an online survey company have been conducted to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of our proposed approach. Experimental results demonstrate that the questionnaire response rate is increased and our approach can be easily deployed in real-world online survey application for effective personalized survey recommendation.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Magnetic Field Gradient Detector Based on Nuclear Overhauser Effect
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to improve the anti-interference ability of single probe magnetometer in natural environment, a dual probe structure magnetic gradient detector based on nuclear Over Hauser effect was designed. This paper introduces the basic principle of nuclear Over Hauser effect, makes a detailed description about the RF excitation system and the signal disposal system of the instrument. Finally, the comparison experiments between the proposed instrument and commercial instrument under outdoor and magnetic anomaly conditions were conducted, the test results show that the performance of the instrument is close to that of the commercial instrument, the instrument has the advantages of convenient for field operation, high field magnetic measurement precision, strong anti-interference and etc, which proves the effectiveness of the dual probe structure magnetic gradient detector based on nuclear Over Hauser effect in magnetic gradient measurement.

articleTitle: Analysis of In-Bore Magnetic Field for Railguns at Zero Speed
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A two-dimensional transient computational model was built in this paper to analyse the in-bore magnetic field. The current density in the rails and armature had been calculated by solving the reduced magnetic-diffusion equation. Through the calculated current density and the Biot and Savart's law, the in-bore magnetic field had been calculated. The results show the concentration of current occurs at the left-hand edge of the rail -- armature interface initially, then the current spread to the internal conductor within 1ms. The field point which closer to the origin coordinate has higher value of magneitc flux density.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of TH Precoding in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: TH precoding can effectively eliminate the interference between the channels in the MIMO system, improve the reliability of the system. Compared with the linear precoding, the capacity of the system also has a considerable increase. But there are still some problems. In this paper, the traditional TH precoding is improved. The channel matrix H is decomposed by GMD. The SNR of the parallel MIMO sub channel becomes the same and the difference of each parallel MIMO sub channel performance is small. Not only this has certain advantages in the performance of BER, but also we can implement the same modulation and demodulation schemes to parallel MIMO sub channels. It reduce the complexity of processing.

articleTitle: Evaluating Singular and Near-Singular Integrals in RCS Calculation
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
