This paper proposed an efficient method to calculate the angles between measuring platform and each LRFs, which improve the detection accuracy effectively. Finally, a case study showed the proposed detection system and calibrating method was feasible and effective.

articleTitle: User Behavior Detection for Online Survey via Sequential Pattern Mining
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, online survey becomes an emerging industry. It is a very challenging task to get interesting knowledge from the large-scale behavioral data of respondents. This paper firstly makes reduction of user properties and behavior data from an online survey company, and based on which we construct an online survey user model, then, an improved generalized sequential pattern (GSP) algorithm is proposed to mine frequent sequential patterns, finally, we give an in-depth user behavior analysis of online survey, which is from conventional sequential patterns of user behavior, sequential patterns based on specific behavior and time window, and user behavior prediction. The experimental results show that it is effective to analyze the sequence of user behavior thorough improved GSP algorithm. Compared with the classical GSP algorithm, user behavior prediction accuracy rate increases 19% via our proposed sequential pattern analysis approach.

articleTitle: Analysis to Space Location Between Excitation Coil and Induction Coil of Unilateral Axle Counting Sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Introduces a kind of unilateral axle counting sensor and analysis the sensor's working principle and the signal's generation procedure, and gets the value of the induction electromotive force by simulation software at the same time. Finally, the rule of induction electromotive force difference changes along with the changing of coil position is given.

Author Keywords: unilateral axle counting sensor; induction coil; induction electromotive force; installation position

articleTitle: Design of the AXIe Relay Module
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: AXIe is the latest auto-test system architecture. Based on the in-depth analysis of AXIe specification, this paper has implemented an AXIe relay module by taking FPGA as the core controller and building Qsys system on chip. It serves as an instrument module in the system and the relays on board can be controlled correctly by the host through AXIe interface. The module has been proved to operate normally in the AXIe chassis.

articleTitle: Design of an Automatic Test System with VXI Bus
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: VXI bus is regard as an excellent platform in instrument bus system and automatic test system. It can improve test precision, speed and performance. After the characters of VXI bus is introduced, the design concept and principles of a certain automatic test system based on VXI bus are explained. Then the hardware and software design of the system are mainly expatiated in detail. Practical application shows that the system is of high precision and reliability, which can provide a reference for the design of other auto-test systems.

Author Keywords: precision AC and DC power supply

articleTitle: A Remote Monitoring Method of Radio Based on W5500
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The remote monitoring has a practical significance due to the large number and the complicated distribution of radio monitoring systems. In this paper, an Ethernet access method for the radio monitoring system based on W5500 is proposed and implemented. The work mainly includes three parts, in detail, design of W5500 module, design of W5500 controller and development of monitoring software. The method presented in this paper has strong generality and low cost.

articleTitle: Second-Order HMM-Based Diagnosis Method for Web Service Fault
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Web service application is becoming a popular and important software application on the web. With the advent of more and more service application using on the web, it is a crucial challenge to use an effective diagnostic technology to localize the service faults. To improve the diagnosis capability for service application software, we build a second-order hidden Markov diagnosis model by considering the dependency relationship of three ordered behaviors in the service process. Furthermore, we extend the Viterbi algorithm to find the most likelihood correct behavior sequence with the exception trace using the second-order HMM we propose. Finally, we compare the correct sequence with the exception one to localize the service faults. Experimental results show that our method is effective to the web service application in the fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Two-Step Robust Filter for Mean Line Extraction Based on the Median Filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A robust Gaussian regression filter and a robust spline filter have been proposed in ISO/TS 16610 to reduce the influence of the deep valleys and high peaks in profiles. However, the differences of the transmission characteristics between the robust Gaussian regression filter and robust spline filter will lead to different evaluation results because of the different calculation methods. It's notable that median process is utilized in both of the robust filters. It shows that the median process is the key point for obtaining robust characteristics. In this paper, a novel two step robust filter is proposed based on the median filter. The calculation process is separated into two steps including the robustness step and the smoothing step. The robustness step is to obtain the robust characteristics of the profile and the smooth step is to eliminate the short-wavelength component of the profile. The experiment showed that an appropriate window length of the median filter will make it possible to not only obtain the robust characteristics but also preserve the long-wavelength components. Spline filter is recommended for the smoothing step because of its advantage of little edge effect. Its effectiveness and application were verified by the experiments.

articleTitle: The Five Main Vowels Acoustic Analysis of Tibetan Lhasa Dialect
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This article mainly analyzes the acoustic characteristics of the Tibetan capital Lhasa dialect vowels (a, i, u, e, o) by using the theory and method of the acoustic phonetics, include three aspects of the data, such as vowel formant frequency, acoustic vowel chart, the fundamental frequency time. The study found: (1) compared with the male, the female student's opening degree of the mouth in pronunciation is bigger, the tongue position is relatively back, and the Round lip degree is relatively high, (2)Judging from the average length, the pronunciation of vowel i is the longest, u is the shortest, this phenomenon is related to the tongue position before and after, (3) Five main vowel is showing a positive correlation with F1, characterized by a is the largest, followed by o, e, i is the least, Each vowel round lip is negatively related to the F2, namely round lip degree increases with the decreasing of F2, round degree of lip with the back of tongue also gradually improve, characterized by a lip of the circle, tongue is the most, I, on the other hand.

articleTitle: Research on Equivalence between Address Resolution and Duplicate Address Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Given the lack of authentication mechanisms, the address resolution protocols (ARPs) (address resolution protocol, neighbor discovery protocol, and so on) are vulnerable to attack, such as man in the middle and denial of service among others. Therefore, the safety problem of the address resolution (AR) has been significantly given focus, and, in this paper, two problems related to AR have been investigated. First, the indecisiveness of the AR is proven. Therefore, all decision methods adopted to ensure the AR are imperfect, second, the equivalence between the AR and the duplicate address detection (DAD) process is proven. Thus, the AR and the DAD process can be replaced by each other, and can even be completed by the same process which will significantly simplify the design and implementation of the address resolution protocol.

articleTitle: Designation of Automatic Pointer Meter Calibration System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Since the efficiency of current automatic calibration system for high precision pointer meter is limited, this paper developed a new meter calibration system based on machine vision which applied a calibration method based on look-up table (LT) algorithm. Advanced machine vision and image processing algorithms are employed to recognize the readings automatically. Sufficient experimental results demonstrate that the system can recognize the reading of the precise meter automatically and accurately, and significantly improve the verification efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic Multiple Fault Diagnosis Based on HMM and BPSO
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For systems needed short diagnosis delay, dynamic multiple faults diagnosis (DMFD) is put forward for the systems of demanding diagnosis quickly. In this paper, a method of DMFD based Hidden Markov Mode (HMM) is established for the system's inner states transform and the corresponding external observing sequence, thus the inner states transform could be recovered from the external observing sequence with the decoding algorithm of HMM, which belongs to NP completeness problems. This paper decomposes original DMFD problem into several separable sub problems, and solves each of them with binary particle swarm optimization algorithm (BPSO). It is shown from the application examples that the system's real-time health status could be evaluated at a high correct ratio with this method.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Room Monitoring System with Remote Language Alarm Function
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the article, there is two aspects of the design with the control system and monitoring system for the engine room monitoring system. The control system with decoupling PID algorithm is designed for VAV system to control the temperature and humidity of the room, and further to control the environment of the room. Surveillance system using PLC with touch screen and GPRS modules monitor the control system intuitively and improve the stability of the system. Providing a new way of thinking for room monitoring system.

articleTitle: Approach to Check the Consistency between the UML2.0 Dynamic Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Nowadays, UML is applied to modeling in the analysis and design of software system widely. However, because of the complexity of the software system, in the UML model, the inevitable will introduce different chart especially inconsistencies between the dynamic view. This paper proposes a method to verify UML2.0 model consistency of state diagram and sequence diagram. First, XYZ/E can express the mechanism of state conversion and formal semantics, so it can characterize State Diagram directly. Second, XYZ/E and Promela are similar in many aspects, an algorithm transforms the XYZ/E code into Promela is proposed. Rules are designed which describe how to use the LTL to express the interaction fragments in UML2.0 Sequence diagram are given in the paper. Finally using the model checking tool Spin, to examine the Promela described system specifications, to test whether the system meets the LTL formulas, to achieve the goal of detection model consistency.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Compensation Techniques in Laser Communication Links
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Laser communications appear to have potential advantage in the future global communication network. However, in the presence of atmospheric turbulence, the performance of satellite to ground links is degraded. Eventually, atmosphere causes fatal results such as the received optical power and signal to noise ratio (SNR) degradation and communication outage. In this paper, the research progress of laser communications is briefly summarized and adaptive compensation technology in the laser communication links is discussed. Meanwhile, control algorithm for adaptive compensation technology is given and we consider that the action with applying the optimized control algorithm to actual adaptive optics system application is that it is significant meaning.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Real-Time Detection System for Shipborne Radar's Rate Gyros
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As signal monitoring method of ship borne radar's rate gyros is too single to fulfill the users, the real-time detection system is designed and realized. This system can help users to judge the gyros' working order more intuitively and quickly through real-time data acquisition and graphic processing. At the same time, real-time index test and correlation detection between the correlated signals are proposed innovatively to improve the detection efficiency. So this detection system has realized the functions of real-time signal detection and fault alarm for two pairs of rate gyros, and it helps to improve the efficiency of checking and maintaining gyros' reliability. The design of this detection system can contribute to automation design of ship borne radar's servo system.

articleTitle: Gyro Online Correction Method Based on Kalman Filter and Polynomial Fitting
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In aircraft ground physical simulation experiment, due to the continuous working battery voltage possibly drop, causing supply voltage of gyroscope sensor is not stable, affect the gyroscope performance. Kalman filtering technology is used to solve the problem of gyro output constant drift, polynomial fitting method is adopted to establish the gyro Angle compensation model to improve the test precision. A MEMS gyro is applied in the gyro system, and the experiment system software is designed by virtual instrument technology. Software system features include data acquisition and processing, database management and data analysis. Then the experimental verification is implemented on single axis air-floating table. After one hour of experiment, the result shows that, the gyro system is capable to operate under less supply voltage condition, and the average error of gyroscope after correction is reduced from 1472.778° to 0.102°, indicating that accuracy of gyroscope and reliability and robustness of system is improved simultaneously.

articleTitle: Ground Penetrating Radar B-Scan Data Modeling and Clutter Suppression
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Clutter suppression is a vital problem for Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) signal process. The clutter suppression algorithm of GPR based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is concerned with the good adaptability of the ground irregularity, but there is still a problem of selecting the main components which exist in the algorithm. To settle this problem, we define the principle of matrix inner product at first, and analysis the approximate mutual orthogonality of the ground surface clutter matrix, the target signal matrix and the background noise matrix. And then, we present a method of modeling the GPR B-scan data. Combining the data model with GPR image entropy, we propose a method of estimating the principal component of the clutter suppression algorithm. Finally, we use the simulation data generated by the GPRMax software to verify the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Transmission Characters of Selective-Filled Photonic Liquid Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The transmission characters of selective-filled photonic liquid crystal fibers (PLCFs) with different filled structures are experimentally studied. To investigate the transmission character, one, two or innermost layer of the air holes near the solid-core on one end of the photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) are selectively filled with liquid crystal (LC). For the LC filled-hole end connecting to light source, with the LC filled-hole gradually increasing, the transmission spectra can be observed obvious band gaps. For the air-filled end, since the combined action of two kinds of light transmission mechanism, the transmission spectra are different from the LC filled-hole end owned the same filled structures. Moreover, when the temperature was increased from 20°Cto 60°C, the PLCF of selective-filled innermost layer showed a good stability.

articleTitle: Based on Adaptive Algorithm Is Embedded into the Low Pass Filter APF Harmonic Current Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The method of harmonic current detection is one of the key to the active power filter. According to the load current's characteristics of the strongly periodicity and repeatability. The adaptive LMS algorithm is used for the adaptive filtering basis on active power filter. This paper researched the adaptive of fixed step size LMS algorithm and the adaptive of embed low pass filter fixed step size LMS algorithm for harmonic current detection. Compare the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods. Designing the parameter of the low pass filter for decreasing the total current distortion rate and increasing the stability of the system. The algorithm with the relationship between the error feedback signal and the input signal to iterate, that the mean square error to minimum. The simulation results proved the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Printed TCM Prescription Recognition and Filing System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) prescription is the text of TCM clinical records, which is a model for studying the characteristics of TCM clinical experience and differentiation of TCM, and is an important information source for the study of the academic experience of famous doctors of TCM. For the sake of modernizing and standardizing of the study of TCM, and study the law of diagnosis and treatment of TCM using modern knowledge discovery and data mining technology, this paper presents a design scheme of printed TCM prescription recognition and filing System based on Microsoft Office Document Imaging (MODI) Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engine, which can extract information from the printed paper prescription, save the information into database, and provide interface to manage the information and file the prescription. It is an important method for inheriting the Chinese medicine experience, especially the experience of famous doctors' diagnosis and treatment of disease.

articleTitle: Design of the Instrument Soft Panel Using Windows Presentation Foundation
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to meet new demands on software designing in the field of testing instrument, this paper implements an instrument soft panel by WPF programming method using Microsoft Visual Studio. The appearance of the soft panel embodies WPF applications' advantages and the soft panel has the utility of controlling HITPE101 data acquisition module through hardware drivers based on VISA. Finally an auto-test system is built to verify the soft panel operates correctly in the design.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Data Fusion Algorithm for Automobile Anti-theft System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Automobile anti-theft system need to use Multi-sensor data fusion. For the problems in the process of multi-sensor data fusion, D-S evidence theory based on the weight distribution is corrected using the theory of matrix analysis. After verification, the algorithm can deal with the integration process operation problem of excessive very well. In the case of failure of one or more sensors this algorithm can ensure the accuracy of the results of the integration.

articleTitle: An Accuracy Indicator of Control System and Its Application in Ball&Plate System
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The control algorithm affects the quality of the control system directly, even determines the success or failure of the whole system. When a control system can use a variety of control algorithms, but it is difficult to assess the merits according to precision indicator and time indicator, it needs a new evaluation indicator. This paper puts forward a control accuracy indicator to represent the situation above. It takes the Ball&Plate system as the object, uses classical LQR algorithm and an improved LQR algorithm based on the deviation optimization to realize the positioning control, and repeats several practicality experiments. According to the experimental results, does the comparison and analysis from the perspective of numerous evaluation indicators, the results show that the control accuracy of the improved LQR algorithm is higher than the classical LQR algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Computational Complexity in OFDM-RoF System Using SLM Technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, study on computational complexity is implemented in a bidirectional 60GHz radio over fiber (RoF) system with 5Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM downstream signals generated by selected mapping (SLM) technique. 5Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM signals are transmitted over one 42km SMF-28 and one 0.4m wireless channel. The computational complexity comparison of different schemes with various number of branches is accomplished. The experimental results demonstrate that SLM can reduce high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) influence. Moreover, the high frequency microwave source is not required at the center station (CS), and the local oscillator (LO) is not also adopted at the base station (BS), that can simplify system configuration.

articleTitle: Study on the Acoustic Characteristics of Speech and Physiological Development of Vocal Organs for Two-Year-Old Children
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Language and pronunciation acquisition for infants and children is a gradual process which is influenced by numerous factors, such as physiological, psychological, and environmental ones. Among all these factors, the physiological factor impose the most direct impact. The maturation process of the infant's vocal organs affected their language acquisition order, with different vocal organs generating different impacts. Based on the study of speech of an infant from birth to two-year-old, this paper links acoustic analysis with developmental of vocal organs, vocal track, tongue and lips in particular, and indicates that during the pronunciation acquisition of the infant during this period, development of vocal track mainly affects their pitch of voice. While, lips and the tongue as articulators, mainly affects pronunciation acquisition sequence.

articleTitle: Communication Module of FC-AE-1553 Interface
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: According to the application of fiber channel in electronic systems for aerospace, FC-AE-1553 protocol draws 1553B bus command/response type of communication, and also has an excellent network performance of fiber channel. This paper gives the details of protocol conversion from MIL-STD-1553B to FC-AE-1553, and system design of the network controller NC and the network terminal NT. In addition, the performance analysis for the system is expressed. This system is not only compatible with the original 1553B terminal equipment, but also can be well integrated with fiber channel technology, and it has a far-reaching significance on overall upgrading of aerospace electronic systems.

articleTitle: An Independent Retrieval Algorithm of Multi-wavelength Pyrometer
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: An independent retrieval computing algorithm for true temperature detection of multi-wavelength pyrometer (MWP) is explored based on gradient projection iteration (GPI) method. Its advantage is no assumption equation of emissivity in advance to realize the spectral emissivity recognition for all spectral channels. 6 kinds of typical emissivity distribution materials is simulated by proposed GPI, the retrieval result shows that the true temperature relative error is lower than 1.5% even if the 5% random noise is input, abs error is lower 30K. Meanwhile the spectral emissivity also is obtained the similar identical distribution.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Wind Speed Measurement Using a Polygon Approximation for the Signal Envelope
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A new technique for the ultrasonic wind speed measurement is presented in this paper. This technique measures the start and end time for the received signal to be detected on a given threshold and calculates the delay based on a polygon approximation for the signal envelope. This technique needs a small count of computation and has a good accuracy and a wide dynamic band.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Inherent Mechanical Noise in PIND Signal of Aerospace Relay Based on Pedigree Cluster
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The inherent mechanical noise is an important factor that causing misjudgment in Particle Impact Noise Detection (PIND) technology. In this paper, depending on the periodicity of inherent mechanical noise and randomness of particle signals, the pedigree analysis method based on correlation coefficient was proposed, to achieve the dynamic cluster of PIND signals and the recognition of inherent mechanical noise. This paper focused on researching the relationship between the correlation coefficient threshold and pulse recognition accuracy rate, furthermore, optimizing cluster threshold to analysis PIND signals with pedigree analysis method. The test results showed that the proposed method effectively identified and separated the inherent mechanical noise and particle signals which contained in PIND signals.

articleTitle: TV Corner-Logo Adaptive Threshold Segmentation Algorithm Based on Saliency Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: TV corner-logo is widely used in current video program, and becomes one of the hot spots in information extraction and analysis. TV corner-logo detection and segmentation algorithm is important for information extraction. In this paper, we presented an adaptive threshold segmentation algorithm, based on the combined time-averaged edge detection and saliency detection, to effectively separate and extract the TV corner-logo from the video sequence. First, we applied Canny operator to detect edges and then calculate the weighted average edge of ten frames, so as to get the time-averaged edge image. Then we combine the time-averaged edge image with the saliency map to get a more accurate segmentation. Finally, we used the adaptive threshold segmentation algorithm to separate the corner-logo. Experimental results show that, this method can effectively detect and separate the corner-logo from the background.

articleTitle: Scattering Measurements from a Buried Object Using an Acoustic Parametric Source
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper briefly describe an experimental work which aims at using an acoustic parametric source to detect buried objects. A broadband (150~250 kHz) transducer is used as a parametric source and transmitting primary frequency signals with CW and LFM envelope at various pulse lengths and bandwidths. Scattering measurements from a buried metal disk of 15cm diameter is implemented in a test tank of size 1m×0.7m×1m. The results show that the acoustic response between the watersediment interface and the buried disk can be distinguished clearly in the time domain by transmitting a broadband (5~35 kHz) difference frequency LFM signal without envelope correction, and the reverberation signal is weak due to narrow beam of the parametric source.

articleTitle: A Novel Dead-Time Compensation Method for Direct Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper analyses the theory of dead time in Direct Predictive Control, and then proposes a novel dead-time compensation method which can optimize the process of selecting the Voltage Vector by the cost function. The simulation results show that the THD of phase current is decreased and the waveform is improved after using the proposed method, which verifies the analysis and confirms the performance of the new method.

articleTitle: Design of LXI Parallel Data Acquisition Module
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of distributed measuring, a parallel data acquisition system based on LXI standard is designed. This paper introduces the core control architecture of ARM+FPGA and modularization design plan. The hardware circuit includes the LXI interface module and functional module. Implementation of LXI interface based on ARM and Linux with completed network protocol and multiple task management system which is mainly to complete network communication function. The function module achieves control of data acquisition and memory data dumps based on FPGA. Then paper introduces the design of software based on LXI software architecture, including IVI-COM driver and ARM server program. Through the actual testing experiment, proves the rationality of the design and meets the requirements of design index.

articleTitle: A PMMA Optical Fibre Sensor for Clinic Radiotherapy Real-Time Monitoring Application
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A PMMA optical fibre sensor for real-time monitoring of radiotherapy dosimetry is presented. The sensor is based on a X-Ray sensitive scintillating material filled into the micro hole located at one end of the fibre. The scintillating material terbium-doped gadolinium oxysulfide (Gd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S: Tb) fluoresces under the X-Ray beam delivered with a range of dose rate from 100MU/min to 600MU/min, and the signal intensity delivered using OFS shows great linearity with the detector background noise removed. The results represent an excellent linear relationship (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 1) between the output intensity using OFS and the simultaneous measurements of dose which was simultaneously measured and verified using an Ionsitation Chamber IC, demonstrating the potential of the novel OFS for use in radiotherapy dosimetry applications.

articleTitle: Cognitive Radar Waveform Diversity for Anti-Passive False Target Jamming in an Active Radar Seeker
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the principle of cognitive radar, this paper proposes a waveform diversity method to resolve the passive false target jamming. Different signal leads to different one-dimensional scattering centers of the ship and passive false target, the presented method focuses on measuring the target and passive false target jamming one-dimensional scattering centers Distinction Degree (DD). Using the Distinction Degree as adaptive waveform criterion and according to the criterion selected the optimal waveform for anti-passive false target jamming. Finally, according to the recognition rate, the method verified the optimal waveform.

articleTitle: Quantum Tunneling Composites and Detectors for Intelligent Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The quantum tunneling composites can be used to develop new sensors, switches and controls for a wide range of applications including electronics, transport, space, medicine, defense, textiles, oil and gas, and civil engineering. In this paper, the pressure-sensitive behavior and mechanism of quantum tunneling composites were investigated. The quantum tunneling composites were used to develop traffic detectors for intelligent transportation systems. Research results indicated that quantum tunneling composites have ultrahigh sensitive response of electrical resistance to external loading, which results from field emission effect induced tunneling conduction. The developed detectors based on quantum tunneling composites exhibit such advantages as high sensitivity, fast response time, low cost and easy installation. They have great potential for monitoring traffic parameter, thus providing data support for intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: A New Template Tracking Algorithms Based on Active Drift Correction
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the traditional problems of template drift and the low efficiency of algorithms in video image target tracking applications. A new template tracking algorithms based on active drift correction is proposed. The algorithm incorporates a drift correction term and a target tracking term. By adding a drift correction term into the traditional affine image alignment algorithms and update the template while tracking, it has solved the template drift problem and reduced the cumulative error in tracking. The results show that the new algorithm has higher operation efficiency and better robustness.

articleTitle: The Design of Simulation System for Multi-UAV Cooperative Guidance
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The cooperative flight of multiple UAVs is one of the hotspots of recent research. The design of simulation system for multi-UAV cooperative guidance is discussed to build a total factor simulation system. It is very important to analyze the algorithm of cooperative guidance and assess with it. Firstly, the component and function of simulation system for cooperative guidance are discussed, then the six-level model of mission planning simulation system, the cooperative guidance models, the fusion model of formation information, the situational awareness models, the data-link model and the airborne data link models are analyzed in detail. Finally, the simulation system of communication electronic war environment and flight threatening environment are discussed.

articleTitle: Novel Optical Access Scheme with 33% RZ-8PSK Downlink Signals Using Phase Equalization
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A novel optical phase modulation signal, the 8 phase-shift keying (8PSK) signal with 33% return-to-zero (RZ) clock, is generated and transmitted in 30-Gb/s optical downlink for broadband optical access application. At the transmitter, the 33% RZ clock is generated by one single-arm Mach-Zehnder modulator, and 8PSK optical signals are generated by cascading three phase modulators. At the receiver, the 33% RZ clock is extracted, and the phase equalization method is used for restoring the original transmitted information.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Detection Observer Based on New-Type Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the convex combination algorithm (CCA) is proposed to optimize new-type neural networks. This method updates the weights by iterating to massage the information in the hidden layer. And a new error function is set up to measure the performance of the neural networks. The optimized parameters can be obtained by decoupling the weights, which improves the calculating speed of the parameters. On the basis, a fault detection and diagnosis method is proposed based on the observer for the nonlinear modeling ability of neural network. Finally, this method is applied to the nonlinear systems, and the sensitivity of the neural networks fault detection observer to nonlinear systems failure is proved by simulation.

articleTitle: A Multi-resolution Fast Reconstruction Algorithm for X-Ray In-Line Phase Contrast CT with Sparse Sampling
publicationTitle: 2015 Fifth International Conference on Instrumentation and Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: X-ray in-line phase contrast computed tomography (PC-CT) with sparse sampling is one of the novel non-destructive imaging methods and has been popular in medicine, biomedical engineering and material sciences. It usually adopts iterative algorithm with total variance theory to reconstruction image. Due to the existence of iteration operation, the reconstruction is time-consuming. In this paper, a multi-resolution reconstruction algorithm is proposed to implement the fast image reconstruction for in-line PC-CT with sparse sampling. The use of resolution stepped-up is the most iconic design of the new method. In this method, the low resolution image is first reconstructed quickly with less data and smaller discrete imaging model. Adopting the low resolution image as the initial image, high resolution iterative reconstruction is then executed with the whole data. The simulation results with the well-known Shepp-Logan three dimensional head phantom demonstrate the validity of the proposed method. The reconstruction time was 50% smaller than that of the conventional method for the phantom with a size of 400*400*400 pixels. It can also save computer memory.
